actions.script: weekFound = false; dayList = [] const L = (text) => ec.l10n.localize(text) const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.TimeServices.get#MyWeek').parameters({partyId: partyId || null, weekDate: weekDate || null}).call() || {} ec.message.clearErrors() const week = out.myWeek if (!week) return weekFound = true const n = (value) => ec.l10n.format(value ?? 0, '#,##0.##') const time = (millis) => millis == null ? '' : ec.l10n.format(String(millis), 'HH:mm') title = (week.isMine ? L('My time') : week.personName) + ' · ' + week.label const status = week.timesheet.returned ? L('Returned') : (week.timesheet.statusId === 'TmshInProcess' ? L('Open') : week.timesheet.statusLabel) summaryText = status + ' · ' + n(week.total) + ' / ' + n(week.expectedTotal) + ' h · ' + n(week.billableTotal) + ' h ' + L('billable') reasonText = week.timesheet.returned ? L('Returned') + ': ' + (week.timesheet.reason || '') : (week.timesheet.statusId === 'TmshApproved' ? L('Approved') + (week.timesheet.approvedByName ? ' ' + L('by') + ' ' + week.timesheet.approvedByName : '') + (week.approvedText ? ' · ' + week.approvedText : '') : '') timerText = week.timer ? L('Timer running since') + ' ' + time(week.timer.fromDate) + ': ' + (week.timer.workEffortId ? week.timer.workEffortId + ' ' : '') + (week.timer.workEffortName || '') + (week.timer.comments ? ' · ' + week.timer.comments : '') : '' prevWeek = week.prevWeek; nextWeek = week.nextWeek; personParam = week.isMine ? null : week.partyId const names = {} for (const row of week.rowList) names[row.workEffortId || ''] = row.workEffortName dayList = week.dayList.map((day) => ({title: day.label + ' ' + day.dateLabel + ' · ' + n(day.total) + (day.isWorkday ? ' / ' + n(day.expected) : '') + ' h' + (day.holiday ? ' · ' + day.holiday : '') + (day.below ? ' · ' + L('below its hours') : ''), entries: week.entryList.filter((entry) => entry.day === day.day).map((entry) => ({span: time(entry.fromDate) + '–' + (entry.running ? L('now') : time(entry.thruDate)), workEffortId: entry.workEffortId || '', workEffortName: names[entry.workEffortId || ''] || '', hoursText: n(entry.hours), comments: entry.comments || ''}))}))
